tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po bzhugs so//

gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// sna tshogs don mdzad der btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po bshad// smin grol nyams len mthar phyin nas// zhi ba'i phrin las bsgrub 'dod na// rang nyid ngo bo nyid sgrub kyi// bskyed rim gsal ldan sngags phreng las// 'od dkar dang ni rang 'dra ba'i// lha tshogs shel ltar dkar ba spros// nad gdon sdig sgrib la sogs pa// gang zhig 'dod pa la phog pas// de dag thams cad ba mo la// nyi mas reg ltar zhi bsam zhing*// sngags rnams mtha' ru 'di skad gdags// che ge mo shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ dmigs pa gsal zhing sngags dag la// rang 'dod ma yin gzhan phan gyi// bsam sbyor snying brtser ldan pa ni// las sbyor kun la gces par snang*// de ltar sngags bzlas dmigs pa bya// don ma grub bar 'bad nas bsgrub// des ni zhi ba'i las kun 'grub// / rgyas pa'i phrin las bsgrub 'dod na// rang nyid phyi sgrub ltar gsal ba'i// thugs las sngags dang lha 'od zer// ser po spros pas bsgrub bya yi// tshe bsod nor rnams rgyas par bsam// sngags la sham bu 'di ltar gdags// che ge mo'i ā yuḥpuṇya ba su siddhi puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes btags ma grub bar du bzla// des ni rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub// / dbang gi phrin las bsgrub 'dod na// rang nyid gsang sgrub ltar gsal ba'i// thugs las 'od dmar lha sngags bcas// spros pas gang yin dbang bsdus bsam// sngags mthar sham bu 'di skad gdags// che ge mo wa shyaṃ ku ru hoḥ /zhes bzlas rtags byung bar du bsgrub| |des ni dgos dgu dbang du 'gyur// / dbang gi dgug pa bya 'dod na// rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje yi// thugs nas lha mo dmar mo'i tshogs// pho la padma mo la ni// rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang*// zhags pa thogs pa grangs med spros// bsgrub bya'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung*// zhags pas mgrin pa nas bcings te// bkug nas bdag gi dbang gyur bsam// sngags mthar 'gugs pa'i sham bu ni// che ge mo ā karṣa ya dzaḥhriṃ// zhes btags ma khug bar du bzla// skabs su dar dmar g.yab mo bya// dar la'ang 'gugs sngags sham bcas bri// des ni brgya byin bde sogs kyang*// dbang du 'gyur na phal pa rnams// smos ci dgos te 'bad med 'grub// /

drag po'i phrin las bsgrub 'dod na// rang nyid nang sgrub ltar gsal ba'i// thugs las lha sngags 'od bcas pa// mthing nag tsha la rtsub pa spros// bsgrub bya dgra bgegs gang yin la// phog pas thal bar brlags par bsam// sngags mthar sham bu 'di ltar gdags// gnod byed che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa// de skad rtags mthong bar du bzla// des ni dgra bgegs la sogs pa| |'joms par 'gyur ro the tshom med// / rnal 'byor gang zhig tshe bsgrub na// bla sgrub gang rung gzhung ltar la// spro bsdu'i dmigs pa 'di ltar bya// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags bcas las// 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi// tshe dpal thugs rje byin rlabs dang*/ nyi zla ri rab rgya mtsho dang*// rtsi shing nags tshal 'byung ba'i tshogs// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud// 'gro ba drug gi tshe bsod dang*// dpal 'byor mnga' thang longs spyod bcas// 'od lnga'i rnam par bsdus nas kyang*// sngags phreng thim pas gzi 'bar bsam// rtsa sngags tha mar 'di skad gdags// ma ma a yu ṣe tshe bhrūṃ siddhi pha la hūm̐// zhes pa tshe sgrub ci lta bu'i// rtags byung bar du 'bad de bzla// des ni tshe zad 'chi nges kyang*// lo gsum bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur// / phongs pa gang zhig nor bsgrub na// bla ma bde ba'i rdo rje bsgom// sa bon phyag mtshan sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros lha mi brtan g.yo yi// rin chen nor rdzas nor phyugs rnams// khab len rdo yis lcags bsdus ltar// skad cig bkug nas dbang gyur bsam// rtsa sngags tha mar 'di skad btags// ma ma ba su ratna pa shu hā ya na pha la bho dza na amba lī wast+ra sarba bho ṣa siddhi pha la puṣṭiṃ wa shyaṃ ku ru oṃ hoḥ /zhes bzlas dmigs pa gsal bar byas// des ni nor dang ldan par 'gyur// / gang zhig tsha ba'i nad byung na// bla sgrub bzhi po gang yang rung*// sngags 'khor gdan du zla ba dmigs// sngags rnams chu yi rang bzhin dkar// lha yi ba spu'i bu ga rnams// bsil ba'i zla ba nya gang rer// dmigs nas gsang sngags bzlas pa'i tshe// sngags phreng zla ba'i tshogs rnams nas// dkar bsil bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nas| |tsha ba'i nad kun bsil bar bsam// ma smin bar du gsang sngags bzla// lam stong sgom pa kun la 'gre// /

grang ba'i nad la gtum mo ni// drod bogs 'don pa ltar bsgoms pa'i// ba spu'i khung rnams nyi ma'i dal// tsha sreg ldan pa res mtshon pa// sngags bzlas rlung rtsol bgyid pa'i tshe// gtum mo'i me dang nyi 'od ni// nyi ma stong phrag shar ltar 'bar// tsha ba'i 'od kyis grang nad rnams// skad cig sreg bsam rlung rtsol dang*// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor dag la 'bad// / rlung gi nad la rang nyid ni// bla sgrub bzhi po gang rung du// gsal ba'i sngags phreng sa bon las// bcud ldan bdud rtsi bab pa yis// rlung nad rtsad nas 'joms par bsam// bum can rlung bzung des zhi'o// / bad mkhris gnyis la rang nyid ni// bla sgrub gang rung bsgoms pa yi// sngags phreng sa bon bcas pa las// sbyong byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas// nad kyi tshogs kun rab ded nas// 'og sgor bshal bar bsams nas ni// rgyab rlung bcug cing steng rlung bzung*// kha sbyor gang zhig pho skor bya// slar yang rlung rnams 'og sgor btang*// de ltar 'ga' zhig byas pa'i mthar| |bad mkhris bshal du thon par nges// / 'dus pa'i nad rnams gang byung yang*// na sar bla ma dam pa bsgom// lam du btang zhing sems bskyed bya// bsngo smon snying brtse sgom zhing sbyang*// bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi bab// gang na de nyid dag par bsam// mos gus mchog gis mtshams sbyar na// na ba'i zug rngu rnams las grol// / rdzas kyi gtum mo bya 'dod na// rang nyid mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong*// zhal dkar sku mdog dmar mo ni// g.yas pas ḍā ma ru 'khrol bas// 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdud// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang thogs// 'khor du rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bzhi// g.yas rnams rdor rin pad ral gri// g.yon rnams thod khrag thogs par bsam// lus gnad tsog pur rkang g.yas pa'i| |bol gyis g.yon pa'i bol gong mnan// lag gnyis khu tshur pus khar bsnol// des ni bhe sha'i 'phar rtsa mnan// lus bsgul bskyod cing de yi tshe// rang dang rdzas dang ras rnams la// me 'bar tsha zhing sreg par bsam// oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa ri ha sa ni// zhes pa stong bzlas rdzas la btab// lus kun dang po sug pa ni// gar chus bkrus la de yi rjes| |sbang glum gyis bkrus de nas ni// sos ka'am nyi ma tsha ba'i dus// rdza yi snod du bla ma'am// rang gi dri chu blugs pa dag

/nyi mar bsregs bskams gar ba'i dus// kha spri zhabs la tshags byas pa// de dang btsan dug bzang po dang*// gla rtsi zhad tsam chang sbyar ba// lus la byugs shing lho byang gi// g.yag rgod gang byung mkhris pa ni| |rlon pa'i nang du nal sham bcug /skam phye chang sbyar thod pa ni// mtshan ldan nang blugs gong gi sngags// sum brgya bzlas la khrog gcig btung*// gal te lhag bzhag bskyar mi bya| |'di la drod ni brtan mi brtan// rten 'brel brtag pa zab par mchis// slar yang drod rnams 'khyag pa'i dus// gong bzhin bskyar bas bde drod ni// me ltar 'bar ba gdon mi za| |ras gos gris ma dras pa bgo// / yang na shu dag zhib btags pa// mar rnying dang sbyar lus kun byug /des ni drod bskyed rkang lag la// ser kha mi 'ong mchog tu bsngags| |/ yang na zhun mkhan dwa ba'i 'bru// yungs kar kha ru tshwa rnams ni// zhib btags lus la byugs pa na// dri ma mi chags drod dang ldan// / brtul zhugs la sogs spyod pa'i tshe// lus ni gcer bur bya 'dod na// bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab// bdud rtsi dang ni bzang drug gi// chu yis lus bkrus g.yag rog dang*// khyi nag mkhris pa na le sham| |de rnams sbyar ba lus la byug /yan lag mthil bzhir byu ru yi// smyug gus mtshal gyi raṃ re bris// gsang ba'i gnas su chu rtsa yi// me rdog gcig bzhag rkang lag dang*// rgyungs pa'i nang du me 'bar bsam// rdo rje'i skyil krung 'dug byas nas// ngang pa'i sgo nga'i ser thig dang*// na le sham dang chang bzang po// sbyar ba btung na lus drod ni// me ltar 'bar zhing bde ba g.yo// / yang na pi ling khyor ba phyed// de phyed dang mnyam pho ba ril// g.yag mkhris sbyar ba zhib btags pa// chang zhim snying khu dang sbyar ba'i// ril bu sran ma tsam byas pa// zhag rer ril bu lnga lnga bza'// lus drod me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur// /

yang na ba dmar ra dkar gyi// 'o ma dang ni byi'u nas byin// klad pa bu ram sbyar ba bza'| |yan lag mthil bzhi la byugs na// lus drod 'bar ro nyams su longs// / yang na pi ling pho ba ril// sga skya mu zi ser po dang*// g.yag mkhris rnams ni til mar sbyar| *|lus bkrus rjes su de byugs pas/ */lus ni me dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ *// yang na chang bzang nying khu ni// lcags snod nang bskol chu chod pa/ */'jam tsam dus su dung khra dang*/ */ pi pi ling dang na le sham// cha mnyam zhib btags ril bu ni// sran tsam re re'i zhag gsum re'i// lus drod me ltar 'bar 'gyur zhing*// shin tu grang ba'i dus byung na// ril bu re re lce 'og bcug /des ni lus drod me ltar 'bar// pho ba'i me drod nyams pa gso// ma zhu ba la mchog tu phan// / yang na g.yag mkhris dron mo'i nang*| |drod sman hril 'jong 'dres pa ni// phor gang phye mar byas pa btab// mnye zhing dkrugs la de yi steng*// ar nag btsan dug shu dag dang*// dung khra gcan gzan tshil bu rnams| |sbyar ba lus la byugs pa na// me dpung lta bur nges par 'gyur// mang na tsha bas mi tshugs so// / 'pho ba la yang rnam gsum ste// mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o// mchog gi 'pho ba rnam shes ni// ye shes ngo bo chos kyi sku// 'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba ste// shi ba dri med 'od gsal ba// rang ngo zin pa de nyid ni// chos skur grol ba skad cig la// bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med pas// 'od gsal mi 'gyur bde chen po// skad cig gcig la der 'tshang rgya// / 'bring ni yi dam lhar 'pho ba// shi ba'i 'od gsal ma zin na// da lta yi dam bskyed rim la// brtan pa thob pa gang zhig gis// bar dor yi dam bskyed rim ni// gsal ba de yi phung khams tshogs// rang bzhin dag pa'i longs sku ni// yi dam lha dang dbyer med du// skad cig grol nas 'tshang rgya ba// bskyed rim goms pa'i mthu ru snang*// /

tha mas dmigs rlung sbyor ba yis// sprul ba'i sku ru 'pho ba ni// rang nyid tha mal lus nang gi// tshangs bug nas ni gsang gnas bar/ /dhū ti phyi sngo nang dmar ba// spyi bo rgya mthongs lta bu la// snying kha tshigs kyis bcad pa'i steng*// padma 'dab bzhi'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus| |sems nyid 'od kyi rdo rje ni// nas tsam g.yo zhing 'phur lding byed// de dag gsal dmigs rlung gyen stod// hika ྄ces nyer gcig gis bteg pas// rdo rje mgrin par slebs par bsam// slar yang nyer gcig tshangs bug sleb// sbyang ba'i dus na tshangs bug ni// sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag pa'i steng*// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rnam pa bla sgrub gang rung tshul// gsal btab gong ltar sbyangs pa na// 'byongs rtags dran med brgyal ba dang*// spyi bo za zhing 'bur ba 'byung*// las sbyor dus su rgya gram bsal// slar yang hika ྄ni nyer gcig gis// rdo rje bla ma'i thugs la bstim// phyi mig mi blta 'khor g.yog dang*// nor rdzas sogs la chags pa na// 'khor bar phyir log byed nyan che// de bas ma chags ma zhen par// 'phos na sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya// / mtshams med spyad pa'i sdig can dang*// mtshams sbyor ngan pas shi ba dang*// sngon nas 'pho ba la sogs pa'i| |bag chags med pa'i 'gro ba ste// de dag gsum la dmigs rlung gi// sbyor bas 'pho ba dka' ba'i phyir// de gsum la ni gces pa yi// gnad kyi gdams pa lus bcos te| |rba rlabs bcings pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// rang dmigs bcas pas 'phos pa na// gang zag de gsum 'tshang rgya ba// man ngag snying las gces pa zhig /'dir mchis na yang dus deng sang*// rang dang skal mnyam ches dkon pas// snod min rnams la gsang ba'i phyir// yi ger 'bri ba ma gnang bas// bla ma'i thugs la gab pa dag /gus mchod mnyes sgrub zhu 'tshal lo// / rdzas kyi 'pho ba bya 'dod na// karsha pa ṇa bu ma dang*// mtshal dkar rgya tshwa gtsang g.yer dang*// gla rtsi rnams ni zhib btags pa// mar sbyar tshangs bug thad kyi skra| |bzhar te byugs pas skad cig la// 'pho bar the tshom med pas na// las sbyor byed tshe ma gtogs pa// 'di la rno tshad lta mi nyan// paṇa chen nā ro'i gdams pa'o// /

'od gsal la sogs chos bzhi po// gtum mo'i yon tan la brten nas// shugs kyis 'byung phyir zur bkol du// rdor phreng nyid du ma gsungs mod// 'on kyang skal dman gang zag la| |sman slad gzhan phan snying po 'dir// tshil chen mar me'i rdzas dag la// brten nas 'od gsal bsgom pa dang*// sha chen rdzas kyi rmi lam dang*// bar do rtags kyis bsgom pa dang*| |sgyu lus chu la sbyang ba rnams// dmigs rlung 'bad rtsol mi dgos par// zhar byung rdzas kyi sbyor ba yis// tshegs med rtogs pa'i zab gnad rnams// snyigs dus 'gro rnams blo chung zhing*// 'bad rtsol byed la bsam pa'i phyir// 'bad med gdams pa rnam bzhi yi// kha mkhas slob ma 'ga' zhig gis// bla ma'i gsung la mi brten par// dpe mthong shes rab kyis dpyad nas// rang bzo byed rnams 'gog pa'i phyir// bla ma'i thugs kyi dpal be'ur// gab nas 'dug go gus pas longs// / lam zab 'di nyid bsgoms pa na// bla ma dang ni lam 'di sogs// yang dag don ldan tshul rnams la// log par lta ba 'byung srid pas// gzhan rgyud log ltas bsgyur ba ni// pha rol log rtog mkhan de yi// spyi bor phyi sgrub mgrin pa ru// nang sgrub dang ni snying khar yang*// ngo bo nyid sgrub lte ba ru// gsang sgrub rnams ni legs dmigs nas// de dag rnams kyi 'od zer gyis| |kho yi log lta tshar bcad de// mos gus dad pa rab skyes nas// lam 'dir 'jug bsam sngags rnams ni// thun thun brgya phrag la sogs bzla// pha rol log lta zhi nas kyang*| |rang la mos 'dun 'byung ba'i tshe// lam 'dir bcug cing phan pa sbyin// log lta tshar gcod ngo mtshar che// / rlung dmigs 'khrul 'khor la sogs kyi// gtum mo'i nyams len gang byed kyang*// me dbang gnad kyi man ngag ni// yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la// dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal khar// 'bru dkar tshom bu dgu yi steng*// mtshan ldan thod pa a mṛ ta// chang sbyar btab pa dar dmar gyis// kha bcad steng du me long la// sindhu ra dang li khri mtshal// bsres par byugs pas chos 'byung ni// bsnol ma bris te zan kong nang*// tsandan dmar po'i sdong shing la// ras dmar gyis dkris brtan par gzugs// de nang 'bri mar smug rtsi yis// mdog bsgyur tshil chen bsres pas bkang*// slob ma'i grangs ldan bshams la bkod// slob ma nyer lnga man chod dag

/zung min las gzhan mi bya'o// las bum rdor dril la sogs pa// nyer mkho rnams bshams tshogs 'khor dang*// mchod pas mtha' bskor slob dpon gyis// gtum mo'i dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor bcas// tshar gcig bsgoms nas slob ma rnams// mdun 'khod las bum chu yis bkru// maṇḍal phul zhing dga' chen khyod// sogs kyis gsol btab rgyun bshags bya// de rjes gtum mo'i dmigs pa ni// dngos gzhi'i tshogs rnams rim gsal gdab// de la thod pa gnas gsum du// btug cing bla mas dbyangs gsal dang*// rten 'brel snying po bzla bzhin pas// thod chang slob ma'i kha ru sbyin// de nas drod la bogs 'don pa'i// dmigs pa slob mas gsal btab nas| |slob dpon mtheb srin gyis blangs pa'i// mar me re re slob ma'i khar// sbyin zhing des kyang gyur mid bya// de rjes bde ba bogs 'don pa'i// dmigs pa slob mas gsal btab nas// slob dpon srin mdzub g.yas pa yis// me long dkyil 'khor rdzas blangs pas// slob ma'i gnas lngar thig le bya// de nas tshogs 'khor gtang rag btang*// 'di skabs 'khrul 'khor rnams mi dgos// dmigs pa dang ni rlung rtsol bya// dbang bskur dus su slob dpon gyis// dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzla// slob mas dam srung khas blangs shing*// maṇḍal phul la yi rangs bya'o// / gzhan snang dbang du bsdu ba ni// rang nyid bla sgrub gang rung du// gsal ba'i thugs ka'i lha sngags las| |lha mo dmar mo phyag bzhi ma// dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu dang*// tha gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin// pho la padma'i mde'u ste// mo la rdo rje'i mde'u can// lcags kyu zhags pa'ang de 'drar bsam// rtsa sngags sham bur 'di skad gdags// trai lokya pu ru ṣa st+rī sarba a n+ya a ba bhā sa sarba wa shyaṃ ku ru ā karṣa ya hoḥ zhes bzla'i dus su lha mo ni// grangs med 'phros pas mda' 'phangs pas// 'gro drug kun gyi snying la gzir// log rtog 'khrul ba rtsad nas bcad// slar yang lcags kyus snying phug cing*// zhags pas bcings nas de'i snang ba// rang gis dbang bsdus bran 'khor bsam// des ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi// snang ba dbang du 'du bar nges// /

bdag gzhan bsrung ba'i ting 'dzin ni// bla sgrub gang rung lhar gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i sa bon lte ba'i dbus// gang srung yul rnams gsal btab cing*// de yi thugs ka'i lha sngags las// 'od 'phros brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud bsdus| |bsrung bya rnams la thim bsam zhing*// rtsa sngags mtha' ru 'di skad gdags// che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum la srungs shig rakṣa swā hā/ zhes bzlas srung rtags spyi dang mthun| |bsrung ba'i mchog gyur zab par gdams// / gzhan gyi byad phur la sogs pa'i// mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog pa ni// bla sgrub lhar gsal lha sngags las// 'od lnga khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// mtshon cha thogs pa grangs med spros// byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun phyogs// gang yin phar la bzlog byas shing*// lhag rnams thal bar brlags par bsam// sngags mthar sham bu 'di skad gdags// byad phur rbod gtong than ltas rmi lam ngan sbyor mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bhyo zlog bsgyur/ zhes btags bzlog rtags ma byung bar// sgom bzlas byas pas rtags thon 'gyur// / gang zhig smyo 'bog gdon bgegs tshogs// 'dul na rang nyid gsang sgrub kyi// bde ba'i rdo rje khro nyams can| |lha sngags bcas pa'i 'od zer las// rdo rje'i tho chen char ltar phab// gnod byed lus ngag yid gsum la// phog pas thal bar brlags par bsam// sngags mthar sham bu 'di skad btags// gnod byed 'byung po'i lus ngag yid gsum ma ra tstshindha da ha pa tsa ha na bhandha mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas phreng bas rdeg cing brab// dmod bor thal mo nyi zla yi// bar du gnod byed bkug brdabs pas// phye ma thal bar brlags par bsam// des ni smyo 'bog gdon bgegs tshogs// myur du zhi bar gdon mi za// / blo dman shes rab bskyed pa ni| |rang nyid bla sgrub gang rung du// gsal btab thugs ka'i lha sngags las// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams// sras dang bcas pa'i shes rab dang*// lha mi'i blo gros phun tshogs rnams// bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam// rtsa sngags sham bur 'di skad btags// pradzñā ma ti sampanna siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ

zhes bzlas shes rab grub pa yi// mtshan ma spyi ltar ma byung bar// bsgrubs pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur// / dam chos snying nas sgrub rnams ni// lto gos la sogs tshe 'di yi// 'khri ba gcod pa gnad che bas// gos kyi 'khri ba gcod pa ni// gtum mo ras kyi gos bgo zhing*// kha zas 'khri ba gcod pa'i phyir// bcud len gdams pa 'ga' zhig bstan// dwangs ma lnga yi bcud len ni// sa yi dwangs ma mu zi ser| |chu yi dwangs ma rgya mtsho'i lbu// me yi dwangs ma me shel dang*// rlung gi dwangs ma rgod kyi mkhris// nam mkha'i dwangs ma dbang po lag /sa chu me rlung cha gcig la// nam mkha'i dwangs ma cha bcu ste// zhib btags sbrang gi ril bu ni// sha ba'i ril ma tsam dril ba// nyi shar nyin gung nyi nub gsum// re re mdzo mo'i 'o mas phul// btang bas kha zas 'khri ba chod| |bcud len kun gyi mchog yin no// / bzang po drug gi bcud len ni// cu gang gur gum li shi dang*// dzā ti sug smel ka ko la// de rnams cha gcig a ru ra// gser mdog ma tshig ma rul ba// cha gnyis 'bras dkar phye ma ni// cha gsum de rnams zhib btags pa// sbrang bur ka ras mgo bsdus pa'i// ril bu a ru ra yi tshad// dgong dang zhogs par re re ni// mdzo mo'i 'o mas phul btang bas// bcud len mchog yin gces par zung*// / rim pa gsum gyi bcud len ni// srid pa pho bcud cong zhi dang*// srid pa mo bcud brag zhun dang*// ma ning bcud ni bdud rtsi'i mtshan// zhib btags dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis// 'go bsdus ril bu mthe bong tsam// dgong zhogs mdzo mo'i 'o mas phul// stobs ldan bcud len 'di zab bo// / bdud rtsi da lis bcud len ni// da lis lo ma me tog bcas// lo ma cha gcig me tog gnyis// grib skam zhib btags de nyid la// rang gi nad gzhi la phan pa'i// sman gyi kha tshar cung zad btab// bur sbrang dag gis 'go bsdus pa'i// ril bu mthe bong tsam dril ba// ja'am chu'am 'jam gyis phul| |dus gsum btang bas bcud len mchog

/dbul po rnams kyi ched du gdams// / 'bras bu lnga yi bcud len ni// a bar skyur gsum cha gcig la// kham bu star kha bsres pa ni// cha gnyis zhib btags mngar gsum gyis// dril ba'i ril bu sha ril tsam// dgong zhogs chu yis phul ba btang*// bcud len mchog tu 'di bsngags so// / 'bru sna lnga yi bcud len ni// nas 'bras gro sran so ba lnga// zhib btags bur sbrang ril bur dril// ja'am 'jam gyis phul btang bas// lus zungs 'dzin cing bcud len 'gyur| |/ bcud len mang sbyor bstan pa ni// 'bras gsum bzang drug tsandan gnyis// cong zhi brag zhun spos sman gsum// chu sman gsum dang rin po che// gang rnyed gser dngul zangs lcags bzhi// gso dpyad bzhin du sbyangs pa dang*// ga pur gla rtsi gi waṃ dang*// ru rta shing mngar shing tshwa dang*/ /se 'bru nas 'bras gro sran dang*// so bar bcas pa zhib btags pa// dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis dril ba// bsten na lus zungs skyed pa dang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms par byed// bcud len kun la rme ru rtse// kha tshar 'debs pa gal che'i gnad// bcud len bsten tshe kha zas ni// rags pa thams cad rab tu spang*// ja'am chang la sogs pa ni// rnyed na btung zhing ma rnyed na// ngal bas 'bad cing 'tshol ba spang*| |bcud len kun la dkar mngar gsum// mchog tu sman pas bsten par bya// / rdo yi bcud len bya ba yang*// lus kyi tsha grang khams bstun pa'i// nyin srib rdo ni dkar po dag /srin med btus pa khrol bur brdung*// gza' skar bzang nas 'go btsugs te// rim gyis cha bskyed gtang bar bya// thog mar btang ba phyir thon pa// bzung nas rde'u 'gags pa na// de nyid btang bas phan par mchis// rdo rnams 'phul byed ja chang dang*// 'jam sogs gang rnyed bya bar rung*// rdo yang mkhar sgong cong zhi dang*// gangs thig sbal rgyab mdung rtse dang*// khab len la sogs ji snyed pa// 'byor tshad rung gi kun gyis chog

/'on kyang rdo yi bcud len 'di// nad la phan yang lus zungs la// gnod phyir yun du za ba spang*// / yang gcig sri'u gso ba na// btsas ma thag pa'i byis pa de'i// mgul du bla sgrub rnam bzhi'i sngags// gser ram mtshal gyis bris pa btags// ma la'ang bla sgrub sngags bris btags// rang nyid bla sgrub gang rung du// gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi// nang du bris par bsrung bya dmigs// sngags mthar rakṣa btags pa bzla// byis pa'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom// sngon chad shi ba'i byis pa de'i// rus pa'am gos sogs sbyin sreg bya// shi gzhug shi kha chod pa yi// 'dod gsol dang bcas 'bad pa na// sri nag yin yang 'tsho bar nges// / thog dang ser ba gcod pa na// rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje ni// ba spu'i khong nas me 'bar bas// me lces thog ser rab bcad cing*// thog ser bdag po'i lus ngag yid// bya sgro mes bsregs ltar gyur bsam// rang ngam gzhan nam gang bsrung ba'i// steng du sngags kyi 'khor lo ni// me 'od 'bar ba gdugs lta bus// srung zhing skyob par bsams nas ni// sngags la sham bu 'di btags bzla// thog ser trig nan hur thuṃ myog rbad mā ra ya li tsa rbad/ ces bzla phus gdab mdzub ris bya// des ni thog ser chod pa nges// / char pa dbab par 'di ltar bya// zhi bas 'bebs tshe rang nyid ni// phyi sgrub lhar gsal de'i mdun du// klu brgyad gus 'dud tshul du bsam// dkar mngar gsum gyi gtor ma byin// sngags mthar 'di btags bzla bar bya// nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra bā ri sha ya sprin sdus char phob/ ces bzlas spos dkar la btab pa'i// dud pa btang zhing dmigs pa bya// sngags bzlas char chen 'bebs par nges// drag pos dbab na 'di lta ste// rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje ni// khro nyams me 'bar ba spu'i khung*// khyung gis gtams par gsal ba yi// 'od kyis sa bdag klu gnyan rnams// char mi dbab na mes sreg cing*// khyung gis zos par bsam byas nas// dug shing phur pa bzos pa yang*// rang lhar gsal bskyed sngags sham du// bhū mi pa ti nā ga rā dza kā ya wāka tsitta akṣi dzwa la raṃ pa tsa pa tsa ga ru ḍa khā hi ma ra ṇa tstshindha bhandha da ha pa tsa ha na mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/

ces bzlas dug shing phur pa rnams// sa bdag klu gnas mtsho chu mig /rnams su gdab cing sa bdag klu// bsregs shing khyung gis za bar bsam// sngags bzlas drag po'i gtor zor yang*// mtsho dang chu mig rnams su brdeg /des ni drag por 'bab par nges// / lo la btsa' dang 'bu la sogs// gnod na byis pa mgo gtsang gis// blangs pa'i bye ma gtsang ma dang*// 'o mas sbags pa'i chu gtsang la// bla sgrub bzhi yi sngags sham du// dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po btags// brgya stong bzlas la de dag ni// gza' skar bzang la bsang rngan bya// de tshe zhing rko bye ma dang*// chu rnams zhing la theb par gtor// gtor ma btang zhing bden pa brdar// bla sgrub rten gyis zhing mtha' bskor// des ni gnod pa kun las grol// / sad kyi gnod pa bsrung ba na// rang nyid gsang sgrub lhar gsal ba'i// mdun du sa bdag klu gnyan bkug /'od spros de la phog pa na// sprin bsdus sad las skyob par bsam// sngags mthar sham bu 'di skad btags// nā ga rā dza rā tri ni hūm̐/ phu phu sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas bla sgrub bzhi yi sngags// sham bur gong ltar btags pa yang*// dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po dang*// 'dod gsol bcas pa sba rim ltar// bris pa'i 'khor lo zung min par// brtsegs nas sa bdag klu gnas pa'i// chu la bskol zhing sngags kyang bzla// sngags bzlas rgya mtsho'i lbu ba la// btab pa'i chus bran shug pa yi// dud pa nam mkha' rnyog par gtang*// des ni sad kyi 'jigs pa las// grol bar nges so bslu mi 'gyur// / gang zhig nad yams bsrung ba ni// bla sgrub bzhi po gang rung bsgom// sngags mthar sham bu 'di nyid gdags// yul 'dir 'go ba'i nad rims thams cad las srungs shig rakṣa/ zhes bzlas sngags chu khong du gtang*// rims nad drag po byung ba'i tshe// rang ngam bsrung bya gzhan bsrung na// btsan dug shu dag gla rtsi dang*// shing kun gu gul gri sha rnams// sbyar ba'i ril bu yungs kar rnams// de la sngags btab ril bu re// tho rangs zos pas nyin re thub// rims nad mtshon cha'i char bab kyang*// rdo rje'i go cha 'di kho na// /

sgrib shing mun pa'i cho ga ni// khwa ta'i tshang shing rnams dang ni// zhim nag rus tshigs lhu rnams kun// re re nas ni me long la// bstan pas mi 'char ba zhig 'byung*| |de gnyis dar nag khung du bsgril// bla sgrub bzhi yi sngags sham du// lha 'dre mi gsum gyis mi mthong bar sgribs shig swā hā/ zhes pa phreng gcig bris pa yang*// shing rus gnyis dang mnyam por bsgril// rna ltag g.yas su de bzung na// mi mthong sgrib shing mun pa'i go// 'di las zab pa yod re kan// / chom rkun jag pa bcing ba ni// pu shud gson po'i ze sgro la// bla sgrub bzhi yi sngags sham du// chom rkun dmag jag thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum chings sdoms bhandha na mo ha st+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes sngags bzlas pa sgro la btab// gri rgyus sum sgril dag la ni// rdo rje'i mdud pa bdun btab pa// mdud pa re la sngags stong re// btab pa sgro dang lhan cig tu// rang gi mchan khung g.yon du bcang*// byi khung nub lta'i sa dag la// sngags btab 'gro ba'i phyogs su gtor// des ni chom rkun dmag jag gi// lus ngag yid gsum 'ching bar nges// / mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor bsrung ba ni// sngon chad las ma byas pa yi// rgya khab mig dang rtse ma nyams// sor gsum tshad ldan rtse mo dang*// mig dang sked pa dag la ni// gsang sngags rgyal po stong re bzlas// slar yang rtse mor stong phrag gdab// oṃ tsi ti mo wa tsi ka wa tsi swā hā/ zhes bzlas rgya khab dar skud ni// sna lngas bcings la rtse mo'i phyogs// thur bstan gyur mid byas pa na// mig ni ma bor bar dag tu// mda' mdung rwa rdo shing zangs khro// de sogs nag po dgu thub yin// yang na gong ba g.yon du bcang*// des kyang mtshon cha'i nyes pa skyob// padma rakta gtsang ma la// bla sgrub bzhi yi sngags sham du// oṃ rno sod zlog chum dril rbad sod/

ces pa bzlas pa'i rakta yis// smin mtshams thig le bya ba gces// mtshon srung gnyis po dang ldan na// khyab 'jug gdug pa'i mtshon cha dang*// dbang phyug mtshon yang thub nges na// mi yi mtshon char ci zhig 'jigs// nga yis 'gro ba ci phyir bslu// / gang zhig rang ngam gzhan yang rung*// khyim du sde brgyad gdug pa yis// gnas bcas tshe na bskrad pa'i thabs// rang nyid bla sgrub gang rung du// gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer las// rlung dkyil gzhu 'dra yaṃ gyis mtshan// slar yang 'od 'phros gnod byed kyi// snying nas bzung la rab bkug pa// rlung dkyil steng bzhag yan lag rnams// 'od zer lcags thag lta bus bcings// sngags mthar bskrad pa'i sham bu ni// gnod byed che ge mo yaṃ utstsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces btags bzlas pas rlung dkyil bskyod// skar mda' ltar song 'jig rten ni// gzhan du bskyal bsam sngags bzla ba// rtags byung bar du 'bad par gces// des ni mthu chen rtsal ldan yang*// bya spu rlung khyer ltar 'gro'o// / dam rdzas ldan pa'i gser ram dngul// mtshal dang rgya snag gang rung gis// bris pa'i glegs bam lha skur bcas// bla ma'i bag rdul dang ldan pa// rtag tu 'bral med lus la bcang*// dus kyi tha mar gyur pa'i tshe// mi 'bral pur dang lhan cig sbyang*// de ni btags grol kun gyi mchog // bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis sbags pa'i// bla sgrub bzhi yi bris sku la// rang rang go cha'i lhar bcas pa// rang sngags bris pa rab gnas bcas// mthong grol mchog tu 'gyur phyir dang*// sgrub rten ched du rtag tu bcang*// glegs bam mi 'bral grib ltar gzung*// des ni sgrub pa mthar son zhing*// mthar yang don ldan mchog tu 'gyur// / gzhan yang bla sgrub zab mo 'di// nyams su blangs pa'i gang zag gis// las phran rab 'byams kun bsgrub la// tshegs med bde blag grub pa ni| |dper na 'bras zhing lo legs na// phub sogs zhor la 'byung bzhin no// de bzhin rab 'byams phrin las rnams// 'dir ma 'thus pa gang mchis pa'ang*// zhi rnams ngo bo nyid sgrub dang*// rgyas la phyi sgrub dbang gsang sgrub// drag po rnams ni nang sgrub ste// phrin las bzhi la sgrub thabs bzhi'i// lha sngags dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// sngags mthar gang 'dod sham bu btags// kun kyang bdag med gnyis kyi ngang*// nyams su blang ba gnad gces so// zhing bcu bsgral ba'i man ngag ni// sngags rdzas dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcas| |'ga' zhig 'dir mus mchis pa gang*// dpe tshan logs su gab ltar ltos// gzhan yang rab tu gnas pa dang*// las kun sbyin sreg gis sgrub pa// gsang chen theg pa'i lam yin phyir// so so'i cho ga spyi 'gro ltar// bla sgrub rnams la rgyas bkab pas// gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du 'thob// de ltar phrin las rab 'byams sogs| |gnas skabs mthar thug mchog gi 'bras// dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub rnams la// dam tshig gces par bsrung ba dang*// bla sgrub chag med nyams len dang*// rang 'dod zhen 'khris chung ba dang*// dug lnga'i nyon mongs med pa dang*// bstan 'gro'i don la brtson pa ste// lnga po med mi rung du snang*// de phyir de la 'bad par bya// kha mkhas rang rtsis che ba dang*| |sgrub la mi brtson g.yel la dga'// nyon mongs mgo yan khengs shing dregs// dam tshig dga' sdug phyi ru 'brang*// de sogs mtshan nyid can rnams la// 'bras bu rnam gnyis 'byung ba ni// chu la mar dang nam mkha' ru// chu skyes lang tsho g.yo dang mtshungs// de phyir tshul dang ldan pa gces// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// dbang dang bskyed rdzogs gegs sel dang*| |rab 'byams las kyi mtha' rgyas bcas// rtsod dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i// dus bab chos su ngas bstan gyi// gnyis 'dzin spongs la nyams su longs// snod ldan rnams la spel ba dang*// snod min rnams la gsang ba dang*// dus bab 'gro don spyod pa sogs// rig pas dpyad cing nyams dang bstun// gdams pa 'tsho skyong shes par gyis// theg pa gnyis kyi zab khyad rnams// lam 'dir ma 'dus med pa'i phyir// don gnyis 'grub la smon pa rnams// gdams pa 'di ni gces pa'i nor// yin phyir dga' bas 'bad cing sgrubs// ma bu dgu las mang dang nyung*// byung na lam 'di 'chal bar nges// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rnams// bsrung ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams la// gdams pa 'di yi gnyer kha bcol// gces par srungs shig chos skyong tshogs// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i bstan zhabs 'dir// mchog gsum yi dam srung ma dang*// mkha' 'gror bcas pa ma lus kun// dpal ldan bla ma la 'dus pa'i| |gdams pa 'di ni nyin skar 'dra// de bas gces pa'i gnad du gdams// nyams su longs la gzhan don du// spel mkhas rten 'brel 'dzom par gyis// 'di la skya ser pho mo sogs| |gdam nga mi bya snod dang ni// ldan na sbyin bya nyid du bstan// de phyir gnas dus phyi nang gi// rten 'brel rtags mtshan ldan pa gces// kun kyang bstan 'gro'i don phyir las// rang 'dod 'khri ba skyungs shig kye// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa zab pa bas kyang ches zab cing rmad du byung ba rdzogs so// zhes pa'ang 'khrul ba'i rmi lam du gang byung sgra zur brjod bya rjod byed sogs la brjed ngas 'khrul ba'i dri ma dang bral ba ji bzhin nges pa'i blo gros kyis/
lcags mo lug la rang lo so bdun pa hor zla drug pa'i gral tshes nyi shu la/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ pho brang bkra shis tshugs su ma nus bzhin du 'bad pas bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
